request.initial_prompt: Mr, Rochester, I, Mason, Good, God, Contempt, Rochester—his. Mr. Rochester, on hearing the name, set his teeth; he experienced, too, a sort of strong convulsive quiver; near to him as I was, I felt the spasmodic movement of fury or despair run through his frame.
